paths.name: sanity
paths.message: Sanity Studio imports are only allowed in app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts to prevent bloating the main app bundle. Use @sanity/client or @sanity/image-url for content fetching.

paths.name: @sanity/vision
paths.message: Sanity Vision plugin is Studio-only and should not be imported outside app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts.

paths.name: @sanity/ui
paths.message: Sanity UI components are Studio-only and should not be imported outside app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts.

paths.name: styled-components
paths.message: styled-components is only used by Sanity Studio and should not be imported outside app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts. Use Tailwind CSS for styling in the main app.

patterns.message: Sanity Studio subpath imports (sanity/structure, sanity/cli, etc.) are only allowed in app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts. Use @sanity/client or @sanity/image-url for content fetching. Type-only imports from sanity/schemaTypes are permitted.
next-sanity/studio is Studio-only and should not be imported outside app/studio/**, sanity/**, sanity.config.ts, and sanity.cli.ts. Use next-sanity for content fetching instead.
